text: Election of the Vice-Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board in accordance with Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures By-law, Appendix A-2, effective August 29, 2023 until the the end of the 2022-2024 term of City Council and until a successor is appointed.
The Toronto Preservation Board: 1. Elected Julia Rady as Vice-Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board, effective July 13, 2023 for a term consistent with Council and until a successor is appointed.
